name: Reolink Live
author: opteon-sdc
description: Live view, pan/tilt, presets, snapshots, motion alerts and camera setup for Reolink cameras on your LAN, driven by reolink-cli.

barWidget.description: Watch your Reolink cameras live, steer pan/tilt cameras, save snapshots and get notified of motion and detections.

schema.label: Default camera
schema.description: Name from `reolink-cli device list`. Empty picks the first.

schema.label: Default stream
schema.description: sub is lighter on CPU and network; main is full resolution.

schema.label: Path to reolink-cli
schema.description: Leave empty to find reolink-cli on PATH.

schema.label: Follow camera events
schema.description: Show motion and detections from every camera in the panel and on the bar icon.

schema.label: Notify on events
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when an event starts.

schema.label: Snapshot in notifications
schema.description: Attach a fresh picture from the camera to each notification.

schema.label: Notification cooldown (seconds)
schema.description: At most one notification per camera and event type in this time.

schema.label: Muted cameras
schema.description: Comma-separated camera names that send no notifications and do not light up the bar icon. Their events still show in the panel. The bell button in the panel toggles this.

schema.label: Event types
schema.description: Comma-separated: motion, people, vehicle, dog_cat, face, visitor, package, cry.
